description: This file implements a Flutter widget representing a 'Home' tab screen in a recipe exploration app. It contains static mock data, UI layout code including categories, dish carousels, search bar, and recipe lists, along with internal widget classes for category chips, bookmark buttons, and data models for dishes and recipes.

classes.name: HomeTab
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that builds the main home screen with greeting, search, categories, dish carousel, and new recipes sections.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the entire scrollable home screen with all sections.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the search controller when the widget is removed.
